content: Bundesrat approves amendments to the Digital Services Act (DSA) implementation, mandating AI-driven content moderation tools for platforms with over 1 million EU users; compliance deadline set for March 2026.
CNIL issues guidelines on legal tech applications under GDPR, emphasizing anonymization techniques in contract analysis AI; fines up to €20 million for non-compliance.
Dutch Data Protection Authority releases framework for blockchain-based e-discovery in litigation, integrating with EU AI Act risk classifications.
AEPD announces pilot program for RegTech solutions in AML compliance, offering subsidies for SMEs adopting automated legal reporting tools.
Italian Ministry of Justice updates eIDAS regulations to include quantum-resistant digital signatures for smart contracts in legal tech platforms.
Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection clarifies data portability rights in legal tech apps, requiring seamless export of case management data.
Belgian Federal Public Service Justice launches consultation on AI ethics in predictive policing software, aligning with EU AI Act high-risk categories.
Polish Office of the Personal Data Protection Commissioner enforces new standards for legal tech firms using NLP for document redaction under GDPR.
Austrian Data Protection Authority issues binding rules for automated decision-making in employment law tech, prohibiting solely AI-based hiring tools.
Danish Business Authority approves sandbox for legal tech innovations in cross-border dispute resolution, focusing on VR arbitration platforms.
Finnish Ministry of Justice releases report on cybersecurity requirements for cloud-based legal document management systems under NIS2 Directive.
Portuguese National Data Protection Commission mandates transparency reports for AI chatbots in legal advice services, effective Q1 2026.
Hellenic Data Protection Authority updates guidelines for RegTech in tax dispute resolution, integrating with EU Digital Markets Act provisions.
Irish Data Protection Commission consults on extraterritorial application of GDPR to non-EU legal tech firms serving EU clients.
Czech Office for Personal Data Protection enforces interoperability standards for e-signature tools in legal proceedings under eIDAS 2.0.
Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information approves incentives for AI adoption in public sector legal tech.
Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing issues fines framework for breaches in legal analytics platforms.
Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection launches awareness campaign on DSA obligations for online legal marketplaces.
Slovak Office of the Personal Data Protection Commissioner finalizes rules for biometric data use in access control for law firms.
Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency aligns national laws with EU AI Act, classifying contract review bots as limited-risk systems.
Slovenian Information Commissioner releases toolkit for SMEs implementing legal tech compliance under the Product Liability Directive updates.
Latvian Data State Inspectorate mandates audit trails for AI-generated legal opinions in advisory services.
Lithuanian State Data Protection Inspectorate approves cross-border data flow guidelines for legal tech collaborations in the Baltics.
Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate integrates X-Road with new EU standards for secure legal data sharing in digital courts.
Luxembourg Commission Nationale pour la Protection des Données updates fintech-legal tech hybrid regulations under DORA for operational resilience.
